# UncleFed.com

> A comprehensive archive of IRS forms, publications, tax tables, and guidance for individual taxpayers and tax professionals.

UncleFed.com serves as a centralized repository for current and historical IRS tax forms, instructions, publications, and tax preparation resources. The site provides both taxpayers and tax professionals with direct access to official IRS documents, filing guidance, and tax compliance information spanning multiple tax years.

## Key Topics

- IRS Forms
- Tax Forms Directory
- Tax Instructions
- Tax Tables & Schedules
- Form 1040
- Form 4868
- Tax Preparation
- Individual Income Tax
- IRS Publications
- Tax Compliance
- E-Filing
- Tax Extensions
- Taxpayer Bill of Rights
- IRS Resources
- Tax Help

## Core Tax Resources

- [IRS Tax Forms, Instructions, & Publications](https://www.unclefed.com/IRS-Forms/index.html): Main archive of IRS tax forms, instructions and publications
- [Tax Preparation Help by UncleFed.com](https://www.unclefed.com/Tax-Help/index.html): Central hub for tax preparation help and resources
- [File Your Tax Return](https://www.unclefed.com/ElectFiling/index.html): Tax filing and e-filing tools and resources

## IRS Forms & Instructions

- [Click Here to Find All 2009 IRS Tax Forms, Instructions & Notices Listed on One Page](https://www.unclefed.com/IRS-Forms/2009/09index_all.html): Comprehensive directory of 2009 IRS tax forms, instructions and notices
- [2009 Individual Income Taxes: Forms & Instructions](https://www.unclefed.com/IRS-Forms/2009/09indvlforms.html): 2009 IRS individual income tax forms and instructions
- [2009 IRS Publications - PDF Format](https://www.unclefed.com/IRS-Forms/2009/09pubs.html): 2009 IRS publications in PDF format for tax guidance

## Tax Tables & Reference Data

- [Tax Tables and Tax Rate Schedules, 2010 back to 1991](https://www.unclefed.com/IRS-Forms/taxtables/index.html): Historical tax tables and rate schedules from 1991-2010

## Filing Support & Guidance

- [Extension of Time to File Your Tax Return](https://www.unclefed.com/Tax-Help/extensions.html): Guide to filing tax return extensions using Form 4868
- [IRS's Telephone Numbers](https://www.unclefed.com/Tax-Help/irsphonehelp.html): IRS phone numbers for refunds, taxpayer assistance and services
- [Where to File Addresses for Individual Taxpayers by Return Type](https://www.unclefed.com/Tax-Help/mailingaddresses.html): IRS mailing addresses for individual tax return filing by form type

## Tax Professional Resources

- [For Tax Professionals](https://www.unclefed.com/ForTaxProfs/index.html): Resources for tax professionals including legislation and news
- [Official IRS Documents from Internal Revenue Bulletins](https://www.unclefed.com/Tax-Bulls/index.html): IRS Internal Revenue Bulletins with rulings and procedures

## Taxpayer Rights & Compliance

- [The Taxpayer Bill of Rights](https://www.unclefed.com/TxprBoR/index.html): Taxpayer Bill of Rights and IRS reform legislation
- [How to Protect Yourself & Survive the IRS](https://www.unclefed.com/SurviveIRS/index.html): Guide to IRS audit defense and tax compliance protection
- [United States Tax Court Rules of Practice and Procedure](https://www.unclefed.com/USTaxCourt/index.html): U.S. Tax Court rules and procedures for tax litigation
- [GAO Reports on the IRS](https://www.unclefed.com/GAOReports/index.html): Government Accountability Office reports on IRS oversight

## Optional

- [IRS News Releases](https://www.unclefed.com/Tax-News/index.html): Archive of IRS news releases and tax policy updates
- [Tax Help Archives](https://www.unclefed.com/TaxHelpArchives/index.html): Historical archive of tax help resources and publications
- [Educational Stuff](https://www.unclefed.com/EduStuff/index.html): American history and civics educational resources
